# railway_deployment_trigger (Resource)

Railway deployment trigger. One trigger per (service, environment) tuple binds a service-instance to a branch of a source repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_deployment_trigger" "api" {
  project_id      = railway_project.example.id
  environment_id  = railway_project.example.default_environment.id
  service_id      = railway_service.example.id
  source_provider = "github"
  repository      = "your-org/your-repo"
  branch          = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch to deploy from. Updating this field updates the trigger in place.
- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment scope for the trigger.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project the trigger belongs to.
- `repository` (String) Source repository in `owner/name` form.
- `service_id` (String) Identifier of the service the trigger targets.
- `source_provider` (String) Source provider name (e.g. `github`). Renamed from `provider` to avoid collision with Terraform's reserved meta-argument. Create-time only; change requires replacement.

### Optional

- `check_suites` (Boolean) Whether the trigger waits for GitHub check suites to succeed before deploying.
- `root_directory` (String) Sub-directory within the repository to use for deploys. Not exposed on the Railway read API; preserved in state and may be updated.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the deployment trigger.
